words.example_en: Now I’ve realised that my estimate of her character was one-sided.
words.example_zh: 现在我认识到我对她品格的评价是片面的。

words.example_en: We will assess the damage caused by the flood.
words.example_zh: 我们将估算洪灾造成的损失。
words.notes: [记] assessment n. 评估；估价

words.example_en: The research project has only been under way for three months, so it’s too early to evaluate its success.
words.example_zh: 这个研究项目才进行了三个月，所以要评价它的绩效为时尚早。
words.collocations: [搭] evaluate sb. as 把某人作为……进行评价  evaluate sb. by sth. 以某事物来评价某人
words.word_formation: 字根 val 指“值……钱（be worth）”，如：evaluate（评估出前缀e表示“向外”价值→评价），value（价值），invaluable（无法估量其价值的 → 非常宝贵的），devaluation（贬值）。

words.example_en: Car accessories include the roof rack and radio.
words.example_zh: 汽车配件包括车顶架和收音机。

words.example_en: Happiness is not a goal; it is a byproduct.
words.example_zh: 幸福不是一种目标，而是一种副产品。
words.notes: [记] bypass n. 旁路  bypath n. 旁道，小路  bywork n. 业余活计  byname n. 绰号

words.example_en: When there is power shortage, they count on the auxiliary power supply.
words.example_zh: 停电的时候，他们依赖后备供电设施。

words.example_en: Plastics are a versatile material in industry.
words.example_zh: 在工业中，塑料是一种多用途材料。

words.example_en: He didn’t add milk nor sugar to his coffee.
words.example_zh: 他的咖啡里既不加牛奶，也不加糖。
words.collocations: [搭] add up to 合计达，总计达
words.notes: [记] addition n. 添加物；加法  additional adj. 附加的

words.example_en: Dust and dirt soon accumulate if you don’t clean your house regularly.
words.example_zh: 如果不经常打扫房屋，尘土很快就越积越多。

words.example_en: A large crowd had assembled outside the American embassy.
words.example_zh: 一大群人聚集在美国使馆外。

words.example_en: He took the trouble to gather the materials for me.
words.example_zh: 他不辞辛劳地为我收集资料。

words.example_en: China will not attach itself to any big power.
words.example_zh: 中国不会依附任何大国。
words.collocations: [搭] attach importance to 重视
words.notes: [记] attachment n. 附件，附属物

words.meaning_zh: 应在（某处）；适合（某种情形）
words.example_en: Russia is a major oil exporter, but does not belong to OPEC.
words.example_zh: 俄罗斯是石油出口大国，但不属于石油输出国组织。
words.collocations: [搭] belong to 属于

words.example_en: Newton published his first work on optics.
words.example_zh: 牛顿发表了他的第一部光学著作。

words.example_en: The optical microscope magnifies the object 1,000 times.
words.example_zh: 这架光学显微镜把物像放大了一千倍。
words.notes: [记] microphone n. 麦克风，话筒  microwave n. 微波炉；微波  microbe n. 微生物

words.example_en: When viewing through the lens, we can see the thing clearer, larger or smaller.
words.example_zh: 通过透镜，我们可以把物体看得更清楚、更大或更小。

words.example_en: Officials want to scan the tomb with radar in the hope of unlocking the mystery.
words.example_zh: 官方想用雷达来扫描墓室，希望借此解开墓室之谜。

words.meaning_zh: n. 回声  v. 发回声；模仿；重复
words.example_en: The cathedral is echoing with joyous hymns.
words.example_zh: 教堂里回响着欢乐的赞美诗。
words.word_formation: 希腊神话中，厄科（Echo）是属于山林水泽的仙女，但她丧失了独立说话的能力，只能重复别人说的话的尾音。之后，她爱上了一位美少年，但遭到拒绝，从此终日抑郁，憔悴而死，山林间只留下她的声音。现在，当我们在山间高喊时，仔细听一听，有厄科的声音在回应。

words.example_en: Place the sensor on a flat surface and rotate it slowly through 360°.
words.example_zh: 把传感器放在一个平面上，慢慢转动360°。
words.notes: [记] sense n. 感受  sensory adj. 感觉的，感官的  sensitivity n. 敏感性

words.example_en: As part of the celebrations, they staged a big, open-air multimedia event.
words.example_zh: 作为庆典的一部分，他们举行了大型露天多媒体活动。

words.example_en: President Bush’s speech was broadcast on national television networks.
words.example_zh: 布什总统的演说由国家电视网播送。
words.notes: [记] net n. 网；网状物 v.（用网）捕

words.example_en: In your Web browser’s cache are the most recent Web files that you have downloaded.
words.example_zh: 网页浏览器的高速缓存区里有你最近下载的网页文件。

words.example_en: She picked up the phone, and began to dial his number.
words.example_zh: 她拿起电话，开始拨他的号码。

words.example_en: A newly-devised microcomputer can act as a guide for a blind person.
words.example_zh: 一种新设计的微型计算机能够充任盲人的向导。

words.example_en: A laptop would be really useful when I’m working on the train.
words.example_zh: 我在火车上工作时，笔记本电脑真的很有用。

words.example_en: This is a computer software shop.
words.example_zh: 这是一家卖计算机软件的商店。
words.notes: [记] hardware n. 硬件；五金器具

words.example_en: The machine is operated through the keyboard.
words.example_zh: 这台机器是用键盘操作的。

words.meaning_zh: n. 屏；屏幕  v. 遮蔽
words.example_en: A list of items is repeatedly flashed up on the screen.
words.example_zh: 一个选项列表反复出现在屏幕上。

words.example_en: The loudspeaker announced each airplane as it landed at the airport.
words.example_zh: 每架飞机在机场一着陆，扬声器就发出通知。

words.example_en: Unfortunately, I didn’t have a microphone at that time to record us.
words.example_zh: 不幸的是，我当时没有麦克风，无法把我们说的话录下来。

words.example_en: He inserted a cassette into the machine.
words.example_zh: 他把一盒磁带放入机器。
words.word_formation: 来自case（箱）。ette是表示“小”的后缀。

words.example_en: A technician loads a video tape into one of the machines.
words.example_zh: 一名技师把一盒录像带装进其中一台机器。

words.example_en: The machine does binary calculations.
words.example_zh: 这台机器采用二进制的计算法。

words.example_en: The BBC has just successfully demonstrated a new digital radio transmission system.
words.example_zh: 英国广播公司刚刚成功演示了一套新的数字无线电传输系统。

words.example_en: We still don’t have the wireless network.
words.example_zh: 我们仍然没有无线网络。
words.notes: Wi-Fi是无线保真（wireless fidelity）的缩写。

words.example_en: High-definition pictures can show detail very clearly.
words.example_zh: 高分辨率图像能够非常清晰地展示细节。

words.example_en: The reproductive quality of audio tapes has improved enormously.
words.example_zh: 录音带的复制质量有了很大改进。

words.example_en: I’ve had my eyes tested and the report says that my vision is perfect.
words.example_zh: 我检查过眼睛了，检查报告说我的视力非常好。
words.notes: [记] visual adj. 视觉的，视力的  visible adj. 看得见的

words.example_en: He is unable to divorce fantasy from reality.
words.example_zh: 他不能将幻想与现实分开。
words.notes: [记] fantastic adj. 奇异的，奇妙的

words.example_en: Science fiction films are very popular with youngsters.
words.example_zh: 科幻电影在年轻人中非常受欢迎。

words.example_en: At the farm, there was an old-fashioned pump for drawing water from a well.
words.example_zh: 那个农场上有一台老式的用来从井里抽水的泵。

words.example_en: A new type of wind generator may offer an answer to that problem.
words.example_zh: 一种新型的风力发电机可能会解决这一问题。
words.notes: [记] generate v. 产生（能量），发（电）

words.meaning_zh: n. 齿轮，传动装置  v. 使适合
words.example_en: Education should be geared to children’s needs.
words.example_zh: 应对教育进行调整以适应孩子们的需要。
words.collocations: [搭] in high gear 以高速挡；高速地  gear up 换高速挡；促进

words.example_en: The mother is often the pivot of family life.
words.example_zh: 母亲往往是家庭生活的中心人物。

words.example_en: The boat has no fewer than five hydraulic pumps.
words.example_zh: 这艘船配有不少于五个液压泵。

words.example_en: The drainage of the city is poor, some of the pipes are broken.
words.example_zh: 这座城市的排水系统很差，有些排水管都破裂了。
words.collocations: [搭] improve the drainage 改善排水系统

words.example_en: Discharge of raw sewage into the sea is unsanitary and unsafe.
words.example_zh: 把未经处理的污水排放到海里既不卫生也不安全。

words.example_en: Some people think that ventilation is the same thing as air conditioning.
words.example_zh: 有些人认为通风设备和空调是一回事。

words.example_en: Reining in inflation can increase income inequality by compressing wages while allowing asset prices to soar.
words.example_zh: 抑制通货膨胀会扩大收入差距，因为它一方面会压缩劳动报酬，另一方面又允许资产价格飞涨。

words.example_en: A long story may be condensed into a few sentences.
words.example_zh: 一个长篇故事可被缩写成几句话。

words.example_en: The purpose of oil refinery is to refine crude petroleum.
words.example_zh: 炼油厂的工作目的是提炼原油。
words.collocations: [搭] refine on 对……进行精微改进

words.example_en: Try to simplify your explanation for the children.
words.example_zh: 设法解释得简单些，好让孩子们听得懂。
words.notes: [记] simplicity n. 简单；质朴  simple adj. 简单的  simply adv. 简单地；仅仅

words.example_en: They open the windows to purify the air of the room.
words.example_zh: 他们打开窗户以净化室内空气。
words.notes: [记] purity n. 纯洁，纯净  pure adj. 纯净的；单纯的

words.meaning_zh: v. 过滤；（光或声）透过  n. 过滤器
words.example_en: Sunlight filtered through the chinks of the shutters.
words.example_zh: 阳光从百叶窗的缝隙中透过来。
words.collocations: [搭] filter through（消息等）慢慢传开，走漏

words.example_en: You can distil the water from the lake and make it drinkable.
words.example_zh: 你可以蒸馏湖里的水，使其可以饮用。

words.example_en: This fever will return from time to time, if it follows its usual mode.
words.example_zh: 按照这种热病通常的出现规律，每隔一阵子，它就会再出现。
words.word_formation: 字根 mod 指“方式，方法（measure, manner）”，如：model（成为一种方式 → 模型；模特儿），modest（温和、适当的方式 → 不自视过高 → 谦虚的），modify（改变方式 → 稍作修改）。

words.meaning_zh: v. 浇铸；塑造  n. 模子
words.example_en: It can be moulded and shaped at will.
words.example_zh: 它可被随意塑造加工。

words.example_en: The prototype for future school building was showed in the library.
words.example_zh: 图书馆里展示了未来的学校建筑的雏形。

words.example_en: This bridge over the river has a steel framework.
words.example_zh: 这座跨河大桥是钢骨结构的。

words.example_en: We must consider a problem in all its aspects.
words.example_zh: 我们必须全面地考虑问题。

words.example_en: The first phase of the project has been completed.
words.example_zh: 该工程的第一阶段已经完成。

words.example_en: It’s too difficult for him to operate this new sophisticated machine.
words.example_zh: 对他来说，操作这台复杂的新机器太难了。
words.notes: [记] operation n. 操作；企业；手术

words.example_en: Many modern inventions facilitate housework.
words.example_zh: 许多现代发明有利于做家务。

words.example_en: She transformed the room by painting it.
words.example_zh: 她漆了房间，使它焕然一新。
words.word_formation: trans（转移）+ form（形状）→ 使改变形态。“变形金刚”的英文是Transformer。
words.notes: [记] transformation n. 变化，转变

words.meaning_zh: v.（使）转变；（使）改变（信仰、观点等）  n. 皈依者
words.example_en: The solar cell can convert the energy of sunlight into electric energy.
words.example_zh: 太阳能电池可以把阳光的能量转化为电能。
words.collocations: [搭] convert defeat into victory 转败为胜
words.notes: [记] conversion n. 转变；换算

words.example_en: If it is not a convenient time, we can alter the date.
words.example_zh: 如果您在那天不方便的话，我们可以更改日期。
words.collocations: [搭] an alter ego 知己；个性的另一面
words.word_formation: 源自拉丁语alter，意为“其他的（other）”。alter ego就是世界上的另一个自我，引申为“知己，至交”。
words.notes: [记] alternative adj. 可供选择的

words.meaning_zh: v. 转移，变换  n. 转移，变换；轮班
words.example_en: The wind shifted to the north.
words.example_zh: 风转向北吹。
words.collocations: [搭] the day shift 日班  the night shift 夜班

words.meaning_zh: v. 转；翻  n.（依次轮到的）机会
words.example_en: It was your turn last time; it’s always your turn to be the boss.
words.example_zh: 上次就是你，每次都是你在发号施令。
words.notes: [记] turning n. 旋转；转弯处

words.example_en: There will be more than one person who can adapt to your personality.
words.example_zh: 能与你性格相合的人不会只有一个。
words.collocations: [搭] adapt to sth. 适应某事物
words.notes: [记] adaptation n. 适应

words.meaning_zh: 调节；改变（行为或观点）以适应
words.example_en: He soon adjusted to army life.
words.example_zh: 他很快就适应了军中生活。
words.collocations: [搭] adjust to 适应
words.notes: [记] adjustment n. 调整，调节

words.meaning_zh: v. 精确指明……的位置  n. 针尖；极小的事物
words.example_en: With this device, we can pinpoint your exact location.
words.example_zh: 有了这台仪器，我们可以准确找出你的确切位置。

words.example_en: Hearsay definitely can’t be regarded as accurate information.
words.example_zh: 传闻当然不能算是准确信息。
words.notes: [记] accuracy n. 精确（度），准确（性）  inaccurate adj. 有错误的，不准确的

words.meaning_zh: 精确的，准确的；一丝不苟的
words.example_en: A lawyer needs a precise mind.
words.example_zh: 律师需要一丝不苟的头脑。
words.collocations: [搭] at that precise moment 恰好在那个时刻
words.notes: [记] precisely adv. 正是；恰好地

words.example_en: The correct answers can be found at the bottom of page 8.
words.example_zh: 正确答案在第8页末。
words.notes: [记] correction n. 改正  incorrect adj. 错误的

words.example_en: The accident was caused by human error.
words.example_zh: 这次事故是由人为过错造成的。

words.meaning_zh: n. 错误  v. 误解
words.example_en: I may have made a mistake in that regard.
words.example_zh: 在这一点上，我可能犯了一个错误。
words.collocations: [搭] by mistake 错误地，由于差错  make a mistake 犯错误

words.example_en: This flaw makes the vase less valuable.
words.example_zh: 因为这处缺陷，这个花瓶不那么值钱了。
words.notes: [记] flawless adj. 完美的，没有瑕疵的

words.meaning_zh: adj. 错误的  adv. 错误地
words.example_en: Instead of complaining about what’s wrong, be grateful for what’s right.
words.example_zh: 要对对的事心存感恩，而不是抱怨哪里出错了。
words.collocations: [搭] go wrong 出现问题；出差错

words.meaning_zh: n. 缺点；故障  v. 找出缺点
words.example_en: It is hard to fault the way he runs his own operation.
words.example_zh: 他经营自己的公司的方式无可指摘。
words.collocations: [搭] find fault with 挑错，挑剔，抱怨
words.notes: [记] faulty adj. 有错误的；有缺点的  false adj. 不正确的

words.meaning_zh: 犯错误；绊脚；跌跌撞撞地走
words.example_en: The sudden weakness in her legs made her stumble.
words.example_zh: 她突然两腿发软，踉跄了一下。
words.collocations: [搭] stumble over 在……绊了一下

words.meaning_zh: 意外事件，可能发生的事
words.example_en: We must always be prepared for every contingency.
words.example_zh: 我们必须始终做好各种应急准备。

words.meaning_zh: 情况；环境；条件；[~s] 境遇
words.example_en: Circumstances are the rulers of the weak, the instruments of the wise.
words.example_zh: 弱者困于环境，智者利用环境。
words.collocations: [搭] under/in no circumstances 决不
words.word_formation: circum/circ/cycl(o)都和“圆，环”有关，如：circumstance（站在周围 → 环境），circle（圆圈；周期），circulate（循环），cyclist（骑自行车的人），bicycle（有两个轮子 → 自行车），cyclone（旋风），recycle（回收利用）。

words.example_en: China plays an important role in promoting Asian culture.
words.example_zh: 中国在推动亚洲文化发展方面发挥着重要作用。
words.word_formation: 字根 cult 指“耕种（to till）”。人类最早的文化之一就是农耕文化——怎样播种，如何灌溉，何时收获，等等。
words.notes: [记] cultural adj. 文化的  multicultural adj. 文化多样的

words.example_en: Western civilisation was cradled in Ancient Greece.
words.example_zh: 古希腊滋养了西方文明。
words.notes: [记] civilise (= civilize) v. 使文明；开化

words.example_en: The Renaissance was an epoch of unparalleled cultural achievement.
words.example_zh: 文艺复兴时期是一个在文化上取得空前成就的时代。

words.meaning_zh: n. 史诗  adj. 宏大的
words.example_en: Their epic fight is the subject of a new film.
words.example_zh: 他们的伟大战斗是一部新电影的主题。

words.example_en: An obsolete ideology can hamper an economy.
words.example_zh: 过时的意识形态会束缚经济。

words.example_en: Asia has a long tradition of tea-drinking. China is no exception.
words.example_zh: 亚洲有着饮茶的悠久传统，中国也不例外。
words.collocations: [搭] by tradition 根据传统；依照传统
words.notes: [记] traditional adj. 传统的；惯例的

words.example_en: The handshake is a social convention.
words.example_zh: 握手是社交惯例。
words.notes: [记] conventional adj. 传统的；通常的

words.example_en: The custom prevails over the whole area.
words.example_zh: 该风俗盛行于整个地区。
words.notes: [记] customs n. 海关；关税

words.example_en: Feudalism was not abolished in England until 1660.
words.example_zh: 英国直到1660年才废除封建制度。
words.notes: [记] feudal adj. 封建的

words.example_en: They thought slavery was morally wrong.
words.example_zh: 他们认为奴隶制在道德上是错误的。
words.notes: [记] slave n. 奴隶

words.example_en: You can’t divorce science from ethical questions.
words.example_zh: 不能把科学与伦理问题割裂开。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 道德上的；有道德的  n. [~s] 道德
words.example_en: The old gentleman claimed himself to be a very moral man, who had never told a lie in his life.
words.example_zh: 这位老先生称自己是个很有道德的人，一生中从未说过谎。
words.collocations: [搭] moral principles 道德准则  moral standards 道德水准
words.notes: [记] immoral adj. 不道德的

words.example_en: The tribe’s development was more primitive than that of their neighbours.
words.example_zh: 这部落所处的发展阶段比邻近部落更原始。
words.word_formation: 源自拉丁语tribus，卢梭在《社会契约论》中曾提到了其词源：古罗马成立时，人民由阿尔班人（Albain）、沙宾人（Sabin）和异邦人三种人构成，故把这三种人称为三个tribus（tri［三］+ bus［存在］→ 三个存在）。字根tribut也源自tribus，指“付（to pay），分配（to assign）”，在古罗马三个“部落”间分配、支付的贡物就是tribute（礼物；贡品）。其他同源词还有contribute（捐献，捐赠），distribute（分发），attribute（把……归因于；属性），tributary（支流）。

words.meaning_zh: n. [A~] 澳大利亚土著人  adj. 本土原有的；土著的
words.example_en: Many Aboriginals do not like the idea of a day to celebrate the British landing.
words.example_zh: 许多澳大利亚土著并不喜欢庆祝英国人登陆的日子。
words.notes: [记] original adj. 原本的，最初的  origin n. 起源

words.example_en: The local inhabitants do not like noisy tourists in summer.
words.example_zh: 当地居民不喜欢夏季喧闹的游客。
words.word_formation: in（进入）+ habit（持有，握住 → 居住）+ ant（后缀）→ 居民。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 本土的  n. 本地人
words.example_en: He is a native of Beijing.
words.example_zh: 他是北京本地人。
words.collocations: [搭] native to 原产自……的  native tongue 母语

words.meaning_zh: adj. 当地的  n. 当地人
words.example_en: He provided local delicacies for his guests.
words.example_zh: 他用当地的美味佳肴来招待客人。
words.notes: [记] localise (= localize) v. 使局部化

words.example_en: The exotic atmosphere will fascinate you.
words.example_zh: 这里具有异国情调的氛围将会把你迷住。
words.notes: 注意和erotic（色情的）区分开。exotic来源于希腊语exō（外面的），而erotic则源自希腊语eros（爱），也指希腊神话中的爱神厄洛斯（Eros）。厄洛斯是一位长有双翼的美少年，相当于罗马神话中的丘比特（Cupid）。

words.example_en: Some foreigners assimilate easily into our way of life.
words.example_zh: 有些外国人很容易被我们的生活方式同化。

words.meaning_zh: n. 外侨；外星生物  adj. 外国的；陌生的
words.example_en: I ran into an old friend in the alien land.
words.example_zh: 我在异国他乡遇到故知。
words.collocations: [搭] an alien culture 异域文化
words.notes: [记] alienate v. 使疏远，使不友好；离间

words.example_en: The anthropologist contrasted two cultures in his lecture.
words.example_zh: 这位人类学家在讲座中将两种文化进行了对比。
words.notes: [记] anthropology n. 人类学

words.meaning_zh: n. 人道主义者  adj. 人道主义的，博爱的
words.example_en: Hepburn is known as a great humanitarian.
words.example_zh: 大家都知道赫本是一位了不起的人道主义者。

words.example_en: They take great pride in their cultural heritage.
words.example_zh: 他们为自己的文化遗产深感自豪。

words.meaning_zh: 继承（财产等）；经遗传获得
words.example_en: He inherited a house from his father.
words.example_zh: 他从父亲那里继承了一所房子。
words.notes: [记] inheritance n. 继承；遗产

words.meaning_zh: n. 古董  adj. 古董的
words.example_en: He wears designer clothes and drives an antique car.
words.example_zh: 他穿着著名设计师设计的服装，开着一辆古董车。

words.example_en: Archaeology is the study of ancient civilisations.
words.example_zh: 考古学研究古代文明。
words.notes: [记] archaeological adj. 考古学的  archaeologist n. 考古学家

words.example_en: It took a long time to excavate the ancient city of Troy.
words.example_zh: 挖掘古老的特洛伊城花了很长时间。
words.notes: [记] excavation n. 挖掘，发掘

words.example_en: A visit to the museum is an unforgettable experience.
words.example_zh: 参观这家博物馆是一段令人难忘的经历。
words.word_formation: 来自Muse（缪斯女神），um表示地点，故字面意思即缪斯女神的圣殿，也就是向缪斯女神学习的地方。该词在古希腊时期指学校、图书馆、艺术学校，现在仅指博物馆。

words.example_en: Modern pottery is usually ornamental.
words.example_zh: 现代陶器通常被用作装饰品。
words.notes: [记] pot n. 壶，罐子

words.example_en: The jeweller will engrave the inside of the ring with her name.
words.example_zh: 珠宝匠将在戒指的内表面上刻上她的名字。

words.example_en: Using extremely different decorating schemes in adjoining rooms may result in lack of unity in style.
words.example_zh: 相邻的房间用悬殊太大的装饰方案会导致风格不够统一。
words.collocations: [搭] decorate A with B 用B装饰A
words.notes: [记] decoration n. 装饰；装饰品  decorative adj. 装饰性的

words.example_en: There are many religions in the world.
words.example_zh: 在世界上有许多种宗教。
words.notes: [记] religious adj. 宗教的

words.example_en: The scientists found that personal involvement in a ritual is necessary.
words.example_zh: 科学家发现，亲自参与仪式是必要的。

words.example_en: He felt very sorry for his breach of etiquette.
words.example_zh: 他为他的失礼行为深感抱歉。
words.word_formation: 法语借词，原指“标签，签条”。法国宫廷礼节曾极为繁琐，故宫廷在举办活动前要发给参加的宾客一张纸片签条，上面写着需要遵守的宫廷礼节和穿着要求等。英语中的ticket（票，入场券）一词与该词同源，读音近似。

words.example_en: His firmness in his beliefs supported him through difficulties.
words.example_zh: 他坚定的信仰支撑着他渡过困境。
words.notes: [记] believe v. 相信；认为

words.example_en: No words can express the secret agony of my soul.
words.example_zh: 没有任何语言能够表达我心灵的隐痛。
words.collocations: [搭] put one’s heart and soul into sth. 全心全意地投入到某事中

words.example_en: We need a spirit of enterprise if we are to overcome our difficulties.
words.example_zh: 如果要克服困难，我们就要有进取精神。
words.notes: [记] spiritual adj. 精神上的

words.example_en: This area was hallowed by sacred memories.
words.example_zh: 这个地区因一些神圣的回忆而受尊崇。

words.example_en: The Ganges is hallowed as a sacred, cleansing river.
words.example_zh: 恒河被奉为有净化作用的圣河。

words.example_en: A holy person is spiritually pure.
words.example_zh: 圣洁的人在精神上十分纯洁。

words.example_en: The election of a new Pope is coming.
words.example_zh: 新教皇的选举即将到来。

words.example_en: I’ve heard a whisper that the Bishop intends to leave.
words.example_zh: 我听到有谣传说主教打算离开。

words.example_en: The missionary was sent to India last year.
words.example_zh: 这名传教士去年被派到印度。
words.notes: [记] mission n. 使命

words.example_en: The priest persuaded him to give up his bad habit.
words.example_zh: 牧师劝他放弃坏习惯。

words.example_en: The Bible begins with the Genesis.
words.example_zh: 《圣经》的开篇是《创世纪》。

words.example_en: I’m just going to the church to see the priest.
words.example_zh: 我正要去教堂见牧师。

words.example_en: This cathedral was regarded as a miracle in architectural history.
words.example_zh: 这座大教堂被认为是建筑史上的奇迹。

words.example_en: The choir sang the Amens beautifully.
words.example_zh: 唱诗班吟唱的“阿门”非常优美。

words.example_en: The man was a monk from Mount Emei.
words.example_zh: 那人是来自峨眉山的僧人。

words.example_en: The temple has been considered an example of classic design.
words.example_zh: 这座庙被视为古典设计的范例。

words.example_en: The pagoda perches on top of the hill.
words.example_zh: 佛塔立在山顶之上。

words.example_en: The empire had for years been falling into decadence.
words.example_zh: 这个帝国多年来一直在走向腐朽堕落。

words.example_en: They made an objection to the imperial system with resolution.
words.example_zh: 他们坚决反对这种帝国制度。

words.example_en: Britain has always had a large navy, called the Royal Navy.
words.example_zh: 英国一直有支强大的海军，被称为“皇家海军”。
words.notes: [记] royalty n. 王室成员，皇族

words.example_en: The Tang Dynasty is a period remarkable for its liberality.
words.example_zh: 唐朝是一段以开明著称的时期。

words.meaning_zh: 年表，事件发生顺序表；年代学
words.example_en: It seems that the paper has confused the chronology of these events.
words.example_zh: 这篇论文好像把这些事件发生的顺序搞混了。
words.word_formation: 字根 chron 意为“时间（time）”，如：chronology（年代学；年表），chronic（长期的，慢性的）。希腊神话中宙斯（Zeus）的父亲叫克洛诺斯（Cronos），因和希腊语中表示“时间”的词 chronos 在拼写和读音上很相似，后来被描述为时间之神。克洛诺斯害怕自己的子女推翻自己，曾吞食了自己的后代，就像时间的无情。正如谚语所说的：时间吞噬一切。

words.example_en: The emperor unified the country by the sword.
words.example_zh: 那位皇帝用武力统一了全国。

words.example_en: The king is the most important person in a kingdom.
words.example_zh: 国王是一个王国中最重要的人物。
words.notes: [记] kingdom n. 王国

words.example_en: They were bowing as the king and queen walked in.
words.example_zh: 当国王和王后进来时，他们屈膝致敬。

words.example_en: The prince fell in love with a fair young maiden.
words.example_zh: 王子爱上了一位年轻美丽的少女。

words.example_en: The princess was ostracised for marrying a rich bourgeois man.
words.example_zh: 公主因与一位富有的资本家结婚而遭到排斥。

words.example_en: I enjoyed all the majesty of royal ceremonies.
words.example_zh: 我很欣赏皇家仪典的富丽堂皇。
words.notes: [记] majestic adj. 宏伟的，庄严的

words.example_en: Virtue is the only true nobility.
words.example_zh: 万事不如美德高。
words.notes: [记] noble adj. 贵族的；高贵的 n. 贵族成员

words.meaning_zh: [英] 贵族；[L~]阁下，大人；[the L~]上帝
words.example_en: The young lord with the red-gold hair bowed, “As you command, Lord Edward.”
words.example_zh: 金红头发的年轻贵族鞠躬道：“悉听尊命，爱德大人。”

words.meaning_zh: n. 骑士 v. 封（某人）为爵士
words.example_en: He was knighted for his war services.
words.example_zh: 他因战功而被封为爵士。
words.notes: 在国际象棋（chess）中，knight代表“马”，其他棋子包括“车（rook/castle）”“象（bishop）”“兵（pawn）”等。从chess和Chinese chess（中国象棋）看东西方差异：chess中的king可以到处走，而中国象棋里的“将/帅”不出“宫”（九宫，象棋术语）；chess里有queen，可横竖斜着满棋盘跑，威力无穷，彪悍泼辣——西方历史上的女王统治屡见不鲜（著名的如英国女王、丹麦女王等），而中国象棋根本没有“后”这个棋子，在一定程度上反映了中国古代的父权封建制度。

words.meaning_zh: n. 保卫者；监护人 adj. 守护的
words.example_en: He became the legal guardian of his brother’s daughter.
words.example_zh: 他成为他侄女的合法监护人。
words.notes: [记] guard v. 保卫 n. 守卫。在英国很有影响力的一份报纸是《卫报》（The Guardian），且该报会刊登较权威的英国大学排名。

words.example_en: The soldiers were filled with nostalgia.
words.example_zh: 士兵们心中充满了乡愁。

words.example_en: My American friend tells me, she is never as homesick as during this time of year, around Thanksgiving.
words.example_zh: 我的美国朋友跟我说，每年的这段时间，即感恩节前后，是她最想家的时候。
words.notes: [记] homesickness n. 思乡情绪

words.example_en: Celebrity, money and possessions are too often the touchstones for teenagers.
words.example_zh: 名誉、金钱和财产常常成为青少年们衡量事物的标准。

words.example_en: Being an engineer gives him a high social status.
words.example_zh: 做工程师给了他很高的社会地位。
words.collocations: [搭] social status 社会地位

words.meaning_zh: 背景；（个人出身、受教育）经历
words.example_en: He is a man with a special cultural background.
words.example_zh: 他是拥有特殊文化背景的人。

words.example_en: It was a truly memorable experience.
words.example_zh: 这真是一段难忘的经历。
words.notes: [记] experienced adj. 经验丰富的

words.example_en: He preceded his lecture with a humorous anecdote.
words.example_zh: 他以一则幽默的轶事开始他的演说。
words.word_formation: 字根 don/dot 表示“给（to give）”，如：an（否定）+ ec（向外）+ dote（给）→ 没有给外面的，没有传到外面的事情 → anecdote（轶事，奇闻）；blood donor（给血的人→献血者）；par（完全的）+ don（给）→ 完全给予，诚恳地给予→pardon（原谅，宽恕）。

words.example_en: His left knee was hurt in a traffic accident.
words.example_zh: 他的左膝在一次交通事故中受伤了。
words.collocations: [搭] by accident 偶然  an aviation accident 航空器失事，空难
words.notes: [记] accidental adj. 意外的，偶然的；附属的

words.meaning_zh: （尤指不寻常的、重要的或暴力的）事件；（两国间的）冲突
words.example_en: A serious incident along the border increased our fears of war.
words.example_zh: 边境上的一起严重冲突使我们更加担心战争的爆发。
words.notes: [记] incidental adj. 附带的，次要的

words.meaning_zh: 繁荣，兴旺发达；茁壮生长
words.example_en: First thrive and then wive.
words.example_zh: 先立业，后成家。

words.example_en: The empire was on the wane after its period of prosperity.
words.example_zh: 帝国在历经繁盛以后逐渐衰落。
words.collocations: [搭] a business prosperity 商业繁荣
words.notes: [记] prosper v. 成功，繁荣  prosperous adj. 繁荣的

words.example_en: This setback has drained away my keenness.
words.example_zh: 这次挫折使我的热情荡然无存。
words.collocations: [搭] a business setback 生意上的挫折

words.example_en: Hardship disposes man to meet adversity.
words.example_zh: 艰难困苦使人愿意去克服逆境。

words.example_en: His misunderstanding of language was the primary cause of his other problems.
words.example_zh: 他对语言的误解是引起其他问题的主要原因。
words.collocations: [搭] body language 身体语言，肢体语言

words.example_en: To them, the monarchy is the special symbol of nationhood.
words.example_zh: 在他们看来，君主制是独立国地位的特殊象征。
words.notes: [记] symbolise (= symbolize) v. 象征

words.meaning_zh: n. 符号；征兆，迹象；手势  v. 签（名）
words.example_en: He made a sign for me to follow him.
words.example_zh: 他打了个手势，让我跟着他。
words.collocations: [搭] sign up to do sth. 同意参与某事
words.notes: [记] assign v. 指派；分配

words.example_en: He put his arm round her in a protective gesture.
words.example_zh: 他用一只手臂围住她，做出保护的姿势。

words.example_en: The address was in Anna’s handwriting.
words.example_zh: 地址是安娜的笔迹。

words.example_en: Generally speaking, the pictograph is the first text.
words.example_zh: 一般而言，象形文字是最早的文字。

words.example_en: Put a wedge under the door so that it will stay open.
words.example_zh: 在门底下塞一块楔子，让门能保持开着。
words.notes: [记] wedgy adj. 楔形的

words.example_en: He made a knot in the rope.
words.example_zh: 他在绳子上打了个结。
words.collocations: [搭] cut the knot 快刀斩乱麻

words.example_en: He is engaged in the studies of linguistics.
words.example_zh: 他从事于语言学的研究。
words.notes: [记] linguistic adj. 语言的

words.example_en: There are two kinds of puns, phonetic pun and semantic pun.
words.example_zh: 双关语分为谐音双关和语义双关两类。

words.example_en: Let’s investigate the syntax of Chinese.
words.example_zh: 让我们研究一下汉语的句法。

words.example_en: He was known for his poor grammar and punctuation.
words.example_zh: 他不通语法和标点的用法，这是出了名的。
words.notes: [记] grammatical adj. 语法上的

words.example_en: Daniel Jones is generally referred to be the foremost authority on phonetics.
words.example_zh: 丹尼尔·琼斯通常被认为是语音学方面最具权威性的人。
words.notes: [记] phonetic adj. 语音的

words.example_en: Did I pronounce your name correctly?
words.example_zh: 我念对你的名字了吗？
words.notes: [记] pronunciation n. 发音  pronounced adj. 显著的；表达明确的

words.example_en: Some questions are spoken with a rising intonation.
words.example_zh: 一些疑问句是以升调说出来的。

words.example_en: She spoke in a low voice, always without inflection.
words.example_zh: 她的嗓音低，说话总是毫无抑扬变化。

words.example_en: The dialect is spoken principally in the southern areas.
words.example_zh: 这种方言主要在南部地区使用。
words.word_formation: dia（在……之间）+ lect（说）→人与人之间的对话交流 → 区域性的语言 → 方言。

words.example_en: He speaks with a strong southern accent.
words.example_zh: 他说话带有很浓的南方口音。
words.word_formation: ac（加强意义）+ cent（歌唱），源自从希腊语借译过来的拉丁语单词。希腊原词可能指古希腊诗篇中的音高安排，进而得来“某种特定的发音”或“用于强调某音节的东西”之义，引申得来“重音；口音；读音符号”的含义。

words.example_en: His every utterance will be scrutinised.
words.example_zh: 他说的每句话都会被仔细审查。

words.example_en: Students of English should have a lot of oral drills.
words.example_zh: 学英语的学生应多做口头练习。

words.example_en: Don’t be afraid of verbal abuse or criticism.
words.example_zh: 不要害怕口头上的辱骂或批评。
words.notes: [记] nonverbal adj. 不用语言的

words.example_en: The stress is on the last syllable.
words.example_zh: 重音在最后一个音节上。

words.example_en: In actual speech, a phoneme is realised phonetically as a certain phone.
words.example_zh: 在实际会话中，音位以某个音素的形式通过语音体现出来。

words.example_en: Each language has a different vowel system.
words.example_zh: 每种语言都有不同的元音系统。

words.example_en: These are common consonant clusters at the beginning of words.
words.example_zh: 这些是单词开头常见的辅音组合。

words.meaning_zh: 字母表，（一种语言的）全部字母
words.example_en: Q comes between P and R in the English alphabet.
words.example_zh: 在英语字母表中，Q 在 P 和 R 之间。
words.notes: [记] alphabetical adj. 按字母表顺序的

words.example_en: ACP is the logogram of English of the African, Caribbean and Pacific states.
words.example_zh: ACP 是非洲国家、加勒比海国家和太平洋国家的英文缩记符。

words.example_en: His vocabulary was sound and his grammar was excellent.
words.example_zh: 他的词汇丰富，语法也很精通。
words.word_formation: 来自 voc（声音），词源同 voice。

words.example_en: The dictionary is a vast treasure trove of information.
words.example_zh: 那本词典是巨大的信息宝库。
words.notes: [记] diction n. 吐字；措辞

words.example_en: “Never too old to learn” is an idiom.
words.example_zh: “活到老，学到老”是个习语。

words.example_en: The phrase was not meant to be taken seriously.
words.example_zh: 这说法是不必当真的。

words.example_en: A confidentiality clause was added to the contract.
words.example_zh: 合同内加了一条保密条款。

words.example_en: Her expression of gratitude was simple and touching.
words.example_zh: 她把感激之情表达得简单而动人。
words.notes: [记] express v. 表达

words.meaning_zh: n. 时态  adj. 紧张的
words.example_en: Dart, who had at first been very tense, at last relaxed.
words.example_zh: 达特起初非常紧张，最后放松下来。
words.notes: [记] tension n. 张力，拉力；紧张，不安 v. 拉紧

words.example_en: The word “intoxicated” comes from the same root as the word “detoxify”.
words.example_zh: 单词 intoxicated 和单词 detoxify 有同样的字根。

words.example_en: To make calls from Canada, use the prefix 01133 before the numbers given here.
words.example_zh: 如果从加拿大打电话过来，要在我们给的号码前加拨01133。

words.example_en: These ships were all numbered with the same suffix.
words.example_zh: 这些船都有编号，且尾标是一样的。

words.example_en: BBC is an abbreviation for British Broadcasting Corporation.
words.example_zh: BBC 是“英国广播公司”的缩写。
words.notes: [记] abbreviate v. 缩写，缩简

words.example_en: Don’t mix up this pair of synonyms.
words.example_zh: 不要混淆这对同义词。

words.example_en: “Happy” is an antonym of “sad”.
words.example_zh: “快乐”是“悲伤”的反义词。

words.example_en: The word “person” is a countable noun.
words.example_zh: person 这个词是个可数名词。

words.meaning_zh: n. 单数  adj. 单数的；非凡的
words.example_en: The young man has a singular ear for music.
words.example_zh: 这个年轻人对音乐有非凡的鉴赏力。
words.notes: [记] single adj. 单个的

words.meaning_zh: n. 复数  adj. 复数的；多元的
words.example_en: A plural marriage is forbidden by many countries.
words.example_zh: 一夫多妻或一妻多夫形式的婚姻被许多国家禁止。
words.collocations: [搭] a plural society 多元社会
words.notes: [记] pluralism n. 多元主义；多元化；兼职

words.example_en: He always put the stress on the pronoun.
words.example_zh: 他总是重读代词。

words.example_en: A sentence usually contains a subject and a verb.
words.example_zh: 一个句子通常包含主语和动词。

words.example_en: The function of an adjective is to describe or add to the meaning of a noun.
words.example_zh: 形容词的作用是描述某个名词或对其含义进行补充说明。

words.example_en: Adverb is to describe a verb or an action.
words.example_zh: 副词是用来描述一个动词或动作的。

words.example_en: You should cross out this preposition in the sentence.
words.example_zh: 你应该删去句子中的这个介词。
words.notes: [记] position n. 位置

words.example_en: The word is a temporal conjunction.
words.example_zh: 该词是表示时间的连词。
words.notes: [记] junction n. 汇合处；交叉路口

words.meaning_zh: 一致的；（观点或看法）连贯的
words.example_en: The policies which will be put into place are clear and consistent.
words.example_zh: 将要实施的这些政策内容清楚连贯。
words.collocations: [搭] be consistent with 与……一致
words.notes: [记] inconsistent adj. 不一致的  consist v. 由……组成

words.example_en: The business is a large, complicated organism.
words.example_zh: 该企业是一个大而复杂的有机组织。
words.notes: [记] complicate v. 使复杂化

words.example_en: As tools have become more and more complex, we need more complex controls to control them.
words.example_zh: 随着工具变得越来越复杂，我们需要更复杂的操控装置来控制它们。

words.example_en: It takes years of hard work to compile a good dictionary.
words.example_zh: 编纂一部好词典需要数年的艰苦工作。

words.example_en: These books are Chinese versions of Shakespeare.
words.example_zh: 这些书是莎士比亚作品的中文译本。

words.example_en: No matter how well a poem is translated, something of the spirit of the original work is lost.
words.example_zh: 无论一首诗被翻译得多好，原作中的一些神韵也会丢失。
words.collocations: [搭] translate from Chinese into English 从中文翻译成英文
words.notes: [记] translator n. 翻译者

words.example_en: The teacher asked his students to paraphrase the long sentence.
words.example_zh: 老师让学生改述这个长句。

words.meaning_zh: 口译；解释，说明；领会，理解
words.example_en: He interpreted the silence as contempt.
words.example_zh: 他把这沉默看作轻蔑的表示。
words.notes: [记] interpretation n. 口译；解释  interpreter n. 口译员

words.example_en: The sailor narrated his life story to me in the tavern.
words.example_zh: 那个水手在酒馆里向我讲述了他的人生经历。
words.notes: [记] narration n. 叙述，讲述

words.example_en: I use pictures and drawings to illuminate our subject.
words.example_zh: 我们用照片和图画来阐明主题。
words.word_formation: 前缀 il 表示“进入”，字根 lumin 表示“光”。本义是“照亮”，引申义是“阐释，说明”。

words.example_en: We can decipher the code intercepted by the broadcasting station.
words.example_zh: 我们能破译电台截获的密码。

words.example_en: The audience are struck by her simple, spellbinding eloquence.
words.example_zh: 观众们被她那简洁、迷人的雄辩打动了。
words.notes: [记] eloquent adj. 雄辩的，有才智的

words.example_en: We communicated mostly by e-mail.
words.example_zh: 我们主要通过电子邮件来交流。
words.collocations: [搭] communicate with 与……沟通
words.notes: [记] communication n. 通信；交流

words.example_en: After a lot of discussion among the directors, the matter was settled in the end.
words.example_zh: 经过董事们的大量讨论，问题最终得到解决。
words.word_formation: 字根 cuss 表示“摇（to shake）”，如：dis（分开）+ cuss（摇）→ 摇散 → 意见不一 → discuss（讨论）；per（完全的）+ cuss（摇）→ percuss（轻敲）；percussion（打击乐器）。
words.notes: [记] discuss v. 讨论

words.meaning_zh: n. 集体自由讨论，头脑风暴  v. 集思广益，进行头脑风暴
words.example_en: Managers get together and brainstorm a more permanent solution to the problem.
words.example_zh: 经理们聚在一起，群策群力，设法找到一个更长久的解决办法。

words.example_en: The government is debating about the education laws.
words.example_zh: 政府正在就教育法进行讨论。
words.collocations: [搭] debate about/on/upon sth. 就某事物进行讨论  have a debate with sb. 与某人进行辩论
words.notes: [记] debatable adj. 有争议的

words.meaning_zh: 评论，评注；批评；实况报道
words.example_en: The conclusion of the commentary really hit the bull’s-eye.
words.example_zh: 评论最后的结论真是一语破的。
words.notes: [记] comment n. 意见，评论 v. 发表意见，评论

words.example_en: We are not about to negotiate with terrorists.
words.example_zh: 我们是不会和恐怖分子谈判的。
words.collocations: [搭] negotiate about 就……进行协商
words.notes: [记] negotiation n. 协商，谈判

words.example_en: My contention is that the scheme will never work.
words.example_zh: 我的观点是这个方案行不通。
words.notes: [记] content n. 内容

words.meaning_zh: n. 媒介  adj. 中间的，中等的
words.example_en: Present’s speech was broadcast through the medium of television.
words.example_zh: 总统的演说通过电视媒介播送。
words.notes: [记] multimedia n. 多媒体  mediator n. 斡旋者  media n. 大众传播媒介，媒体（如电视、广播等）

words.meaning_zh: 新闻界，记者；报刊；出版社
words.example_en: The power of the press is very great.
words.example_zh: 新闻界的力量非常大。
words.word_formation: 字根 press 指“压”。单词 press 作动词时有“挤压”的含义，同源词又如：compress（大家一起压 → 压紧，压缩），depress（向下压 → 使沮丧；使萧条），express（挤压出来 → 表示；快递服务），impress（压进去 → 给……留下印象）。

words.example_en: No journalist was bold enough to challenge the Prime Minister.
words.example_zh: 没有一个记者大胆到敢挑战首相。
words.word_formation: 源自法语，法语中的 journal 表示“每天的：日记，日志；日报”，而“期刊，杂志”的含义是后来引申来的。所以 journalist 就是“把每天发生的事情都记录下来的人”，journalism 是这样的行业，即“新闻业”。

words.example_en: The critics said the new movie would not do well at the box office.
words.example_zh: 评论家说那部新电影的票房不会太好。
words.collocations: [搭] a movie critic 影评人  a theatre critic 剧评家
words.word_formation: 字根 crit 指“判断（to judge）”，如：crit（判断）+ erion（名词后缀）→判断的东西，判断的依据→criterion（标准）。
words.notes: [记] critical adj. 批评的；挑剔的  criticism n. 批评，指责  criticise (= criticize) v. 批评

words.example_en: I enjoy this sports commentator’s commentaries very much.
words.example_zh: 我非常喜欢这位体育运动实况解说员的解说。

words.example_en: He is an exponent of the opinions of Einstein.
words.example_zh: 他是爱因斯坦理论的拥护者。

words.example_en: The announcer started with the day’s top stories.
words.example_zh: 播音员一上来就播报了一天中的头条新闻。
words.notes: [记] announce v. 宣布；播报

words.example_en: That war correspondent proudly outgunned the army sharpshooters.
words.example_zh: 那位战地记者比军队神枪手的枪法还准，觉得很自豪。
words.collocations: [搭] a war correspondent 战地记者

words.example_en: The messenger brought your note today.
words.example_zh: 信使今天带来了给你的短笺。
words.notes: [记] message n. 信息 v. 给……发（电子）信息

words.meaning_zh: 编辑，校订者；（电台或电视台的）记者，编辑
words.example_en: She gave the editor a dishonest account of this event.
words.example_zh: 她给了记者一份有关该事件的不实叙述。
words.collocations: [搭] chief editor 主编，总编
words.notes: [记] edit v. 编辑，校订；剪辑

words.example_en: The two typists have already worked all day.
words.example_zh: 这两位打字员已经工作一整天了。
words.collocations: [搭] a shorthand typist 速记打字员
words.notes: [记] type v. 打字

words.example_en: Please read the handout carefully.
words.example_zh: 请仔细阅读这份讲义。

words.meaning_zh: n. 传单  v. 散发传单
words.example_en: We were paid to leaflet advertisements in the shopping mall.
words.example_zh: 有人雇我们在购物中心发放广告传单。

words.example_en: These reports clearly contain elements of propaganda.
words.example_zh: 这些报道明显含有一些宣传元素。

words.example_en: News of the pop star’s sudden death was not published for several days.
words.example_zh: 那位明星突然死亡的消息有好几天没有公布。
words.notes: [记] public n. 公众 adj. 公众的  publicity n. 关注，宣传  publication n. 出版物；出版，发行

words.example_en: The agency would collect and disseminate information.
words.example_zh: 通讯社会收集和传播信息。

words.example_en: They cannot foresee how things will turn out.
words.example_zh: 他们不可能预知事情的结果。
words.word_formation: 前缀 fore 表示“前面的”，如：foresee（预见），forearm（前臂），forebear（以前生[bear]的人→祖先），forefather（爸爸之前的爸爸→祖先）。

words.example_en: Sales are better than they have anticipated.
words.example_zh: 销售情况比他们预想的好。
words.notes: [记] participate v. 参与

words.example_en: The managers expect exceptional sales growth in the last quarter.
words.example_zh: 经理们预期在最后一个季度会出现极好的销售增长。
words.notes: [记] expectation n. 期待，期望

words.meaning_zh: 等候，期待；将降临到……身上
words.example_en: If you are lucky enough to vacation in the Alps, what delights will await you?
words.example_zh: 如果你有幸到阿尔卑斯山度假的话，有什么乐事会等着你呢？

words.example_en: Listening to music is the favourite pastime of many people all over the world.
words.example_zh: 听音乐是全世界许多人最喜爱的消遣。

words.example_en: This television programme is designed to educate and to entertain as well.
words.example_zh: 这台电视节目旨在又有教育作用，又能让大家快乐。
words.notes: [记] entertainment n. 娱乐，消遣；款待

words.example_en: She is in charge of recreation.
words.example_zh: 她负责娱乐活动。
words.collocations: [搭] a recreation ground 公共娱乐场

words.example_en: Harry makes up funny stories to amuse his little brother.
words.example_zh: 哈利编有趣的故事来逗他的弟弟。
words.collocations: [搭] amuse oneself 自娱自乐
words.word_formation: 可能与缪斯（Muse）有关，即司历史、音乐、文学等的九位女神之一。动词 muse 有“沉思”之义，而 amuse 最初是指“使沉思”“使目不转睛地盯着”。amusement park 是“游乐场”，猜猜下面这些词对应的英语表达：过山车，碰碰车，摩天轮，旋转木马。这些都是现在小学英语课本收录的词语：roller coaster，bumper car，big wheel / Ferris wheel，merry-go-round。

words.example_en: I’ve read about it in the gossip column.
words.example_zh: 我在八卦栏目曾看过有关这件事的报道。

words.example_en: The rumour soon swept the entire company.
words.example_zh: 谣言很快传遍了全公司。
words.notes: (= rumor) 注意拼写：rumour = rumor；humour = humor。联想记忆：rude humour（粗鲁的幽默）→ rumour（谣言）。与 gossip 的区别：gossip 指“流言，八卦消息”，如 celebrity gossip 就是“名人的八卦新闻”。

words.example_en: Could we reach a consensus on this issue? Let’s take a vote.
words.example_zh: 我们能在该问题上达成一致吗？让我们来投票表决吧。

words.example_en: This music festival will feature fireworks, live music, and barbecue.
words.example_zh: 这音乐节上将有烟花表演、现场音乐表演和烧烤野餐。

words.example_en: The feast was served by his mother and sisters.
words.example_zh: 这顿美餐是他母亲和他的姐妹们准备的。

words.meaning_zh: (= program) n. 节目；方案；（演出或活动的）程序  v. 为（系统）设定程序；计划
words.example_en: There was an interesting programme on TV yesterday.
words.example_zh: 昨天有个很有趣的电视节目。
words.notes: [记] programmer n. 程序设计员

words.example_en: The play is in rehearsal now.
words.example_zh: 这出戏正在排演中。

words.example_en: A jazz band will perform live at tomorrow’s party.
words.example_zh: 一个爵士乐队将在明天的聚会上进行现场表演。

words.example_en: He imitates other people to perfection.
words.example_zh: 他模仿别人模仿得惟妙惟肖。

words.example_en: He mimicked the teacher’s accent.
words.example_zh: 他模仿老师的口音。

words.example_en: We can use computers to simulate many situations.
words.example_zh: 我们可以用计算机模拟各种情况。
words.notes: [记] simulative adj. 模拟的；假装的

words.meaning_zh: 马戏团；圆形广场（常用于地名）
words.example_en: Last Christmas, the circus owner decided to take some presents to a children’s hospital.
words.example_zh: 去年圣诞节，马戏团老板决定给一家儿童医院送些礼物。
words.collocations: [搭] a circus clown 马戏团小丑

words.example_en: The magician thrilled his audience with his magic.
words.example_zh: 魔术师用他的魔术使观众们激动万分。

words.example_en: My brother was studying a course in drama at university.
words.example_zh: 我哥哥正在大学里学习戏剧课程。
words.notes: [记] dramatic adj. 戏剧性的

words.example_en: Various performers will present a concert to raise money for AIDS charities.
words.example_zh: 众多表演艺术家将会出席一场音乐会来为艾滋病慈善机构募捐。
words.collocations: [搭] in concert with 与……合作
words.notes: [记] musicale n. 社交音乐会  concertmaster n. 首席小提琴手  concertgoer n. 常去听音乐会者  concerto n. 协奏曲  conductor n.（管弦乐队、合唱团等的）指挥  melody n. 旋律  rhythm n. 节奏  lyrics n. 歌词  score n. 总谱

words.example_en: The Royal Stockholm Philharmonic Orchestra played Beethoven’s Ninth Symphony.
words.example_zh: 皇家斯德哥尔摩爱乐乐团演奏了贝多芬的《第九交响曲》。

words.example_en: This orchestra has been established under the patronage of the government.
words.example_zh: 这个管弦乐队是在政府的赞助下成立的。

words.example_en: I wanted to be a ballet dancer when I was a child.
words.example_zh: 当我还是个孩子时，我想成为芭蕾舞演员。
words.collocations: [搭] ice ballet 冰上芭蕾  water ballet 水上芭蕾  Swan Lake 即著名的芭蕾舞剧《天鹅湖》。

words.example_en: She joined the Royal Opera House the following year.
words.example_zh: 她于次年加入了皇家歌剧院。
words.collocations: [搭] Beijing/Peking opera 京剧

words.example_en: Dwayne Johnson talked about his experiences of starring in comedies.
words.example_zh: 道恩·强森谈论了自己主演喜剧片的经历。

words.example_en: She was too exhausted and distressed to talk about the tragedy.
words.example_zh: 她太累了，而且无比悲伤，没法谈论那场悲剧。

words.example_en: It is this cartoon that brought the animation industry back from the dead.
words.example_zh: 正是这部卡通片使动画产业起死回生。

words.example_en: A good film will be on this weekend.
words.example_zh: 这周末会有一部精彩的电影上映。

words.example_en: This movie was hyped up in the media before it was screened.
words.example_zh: 这部影片在上映前被媒体大肆吹捧了一番。

words.example_en: When Logan was showed in cinema, it was X-rated.
words.example_zh: 《金刚狼3》在电影院上映时被定为了X级。

words.example_en: He was not the kind of artist who could work collaboratively.
words.example_zh: 他不是那种能够与人合作的艺术家。
words.notes: [记] art n. 艺术  artistic adj. 艺术的；艺术家的

words.example_en: The original designs were made by highly skilled craftsmen.
words.example_zh: 原始的图案是由技艺高超的工匠绘制的。
words.notes: [记] craft n. 工艺 v. 精心制作

words.example_en: This painter is not first-class.
words.example_zh: 这位画家并非一流。

words.example_en: I played the role of the mean aunt in the play.
words.example_zh: 我在剧中扮演了刻薄的姨母这一角色。
words.collocations: [搭] play a role in 在……中起作用

words.example_en: The scene is perfect when you see the sun rising slowly in the east.
words.example_zh: 观看太阳从东方慢慢升起，这种景色太美了。

words.meaning_zh: 舞台；阶段；[the ~] 戏剧演出
words.example_en: Each stage of the battle was carried off flawlessly.
words.example_zh: 战斗的每个阶段都进展顺利。

words.example_en: The pictures in the gallery were well spaced out.
words.example_zh: 画廊中各幅画的间隔安排得很好。

words.example_en: They are coming to the exhibition as my guests.
words.example_zh: 他们作为我邀请的客人来参观展览。

words.meaning_zh: (= esthetic) adj. 审美的  n. 审美观
words.example_en: His aesthetic standards are quite different from mine.
words.example_zh: 他的审美标准与我的相当不同。

words.example_en: He used to collect stamps, but now he likes to collect coins.
words.example_zh: 他以前收集邮票，现在却喜欢收集硬币。
words.notes: [记] collection n. 收集；收藏品

words.meaning_zh: v. 选择，挑选  adj. 精选的
words.example_en: They were selected from many applicants.
words.example_zh: 他们是从许多申请人中选出来的。
words.notes: [记] selection n. 选择

words.example_en: My aunt opted for early retirement.
words.example_zh: 我姑姑选择了提早退休。
words.collocations: [搭] opt for sth. 选择某事物
words.notes: [记] option n. 选择；选择权

words.example_en: His photograph showed how the plant turned out.
words.example_zh: 他的照片展示了这株植物长成了什么样。
words.word_formation: gram/graph(y) 指“写（to write），画（to draw）”，如：grammar（书写的方法→语法）；bio（生命）+ graphy（写）→书写生命→biography（传记）；photo（光）+ graphy（写，画）→用光来描绘→photography（摄影，照相术）。
words.notes: [记] photographic adj. 摄影的，摄制的

words.example_en: Her portrait hangs in the lobby of the library.
words.example_zh: 她的肖像挂在图书馆的大厅里。

words.example_en: This painting is invaluable.
words.example_zh: 这幅画是非常珍贵的。

words.example_en: The smooth contour of the sculpture is wonderful.
words.example_zh: 这座雕塑流畅的轮廓线真是太美了。

words.example_en: Draw a line with a ruler.
words.example_zh: 用尺子画一条线。
words.notes: [记] drawing n. 图画，素描画；绘图（技巧）

words.meaning_zh: n. 素描，速写，草图  v. 画素描，画速写
words.example_en: I sketched the cat sleeping in the yard.
words.example_zh: 我给正在院子里睡觉的那只猫画了个速写。
words.collocations: [搭] sketch out 画出……的轮廓；简略地叙述

words.example_en: In this new biography, she is depicted as a lonely and unhappy woman.
words.example_zh: 在这本新的传记中，她被描写为孤独且不快乐的女人。
words.word_formation: 字根 pict 指“画（to paint）”，如：depict（画下来→描绘；描写），pictograph（用画画来写字→象形文字），picture（画；照片）。

words.example_en: Words cannot describe the beauty of the scene.
words.example_zh: 语言难以描述出这景色的优美。
words.notes: [记] description n. 描述

words.example_en: The statue was carved out of marble.
words.example_zh: 这尊雕塑是用大理石雕成的。
words.collocations: [搭] carve up 瓜分，划分

words.example_en: If an actor forgets his lines on stage, he has to improvise.
words.example_zh: 如果一个演员在舞台上忘了台词，他就不得不即兴发挥。
words.word_formation: im（否定）+ pro（预先）+ vise（看见）→ 预先没有看见→即兴创作；临时做。字根 vis(e) 指“看见（to see）”，如：provision（事先看到→供应；预备），previse（预见），supervise（从上往下看→监督；管理）。
words.notes: [记] improvisation n. 即兴创作

words.example_en: The drum is one of the oldest musical instruments.
words.example_zh: 鼓是最古老的乐器之一。
words.notes: [记] musician n. 音乐家，作曲家

words.example_en: Beethoven is regarded as one of the immortals of classical music.
words.example_zh: 贝多芬被认为是古典音乐界的不朽人物之一。

words.example_en: He is well versed in many styles of jazz.
words.example_zh: 他精通多种风格的爵士乐。

words.example_en: Glam rock developed in the early 1970s and David Bowie was one of the most influential glam rock artists.
words.example_zh: 华丽摇滚发展于20世纪70年代早期，大卫·鲍伊是最具影响力的华丽摇滚艺术家之一。

words.example_en: Hip-hop singers like to wear bling-bling in their music videos to look fancy.
words.example_zh: 在音乐录影带里，嘻哈歌手喜欢穿得珠光宝气，让自己看起来很炫。

words.example_en: The radio had fed him a stream of pop songs.
words.example_zh: 他从广播里听到了一连串流行歌曲。
words.word_formation: pop 表示“流行音乐”时源自 popular（流行的）。pop 还可表示“发砰声；爆裂；突然出现”，这些词义源自拟声。

words.meaning_zh: n. 抒情诗；[~s] 歌词  adj. 抒情的
words.example_en: I don’t understand the lyrics, which are in French, but the song sounds peaceful.
words.example_zh: 我听不懂法语歌词，但是这首歌听起来让人感觉很宁静。

words.example_en: The band will play on request.
words.example_zh: 该乐队会按点播要求演奏节目。

words.meaning_zh: n. 独奏，独唱  adj. 独奏的，独唱的；单独的
words.example_en: She has acquired a reputation as this country’s premier solo violinist.
words.example_zh: 她赢得了该国首席小提琴独奏家的名誉。

words.example_en: I like that song, because its melody is really pleasant.
words.example_zh: 我喜欢那首歌，因为它的旋律十分悦耳。

words.example_en: I can’t dance to music without a good rhythm.
words.example_zh: 没有好的节奏我就不能跟着音乐跳舞。
words.notes: [记] rhythmical adj. 有节奏的，有韵律的  目前较流行的音乐曲风 R & B 指的就是“rhythm and blues”，即“节奏布鲁斯”。

words.example_en: This violin has a very good tone.
words.example_zh: 这把小提琴的音色很好。

words.meaning_zh: n. 曲调；短乐曲  v. 调试
words.example_en: The violin seems to be out of tune.
words.example_zh: 小提琴的声音好像走调了。
words.notes: [记] tuner n. 调音者

words.meaning_zh: (= disk) n. 光碟；唱片；[英]（计算机）磁碟，磁盘
words.example_en: There is no disc that interest me.
words.example_zh: 这里没有一张碟片让我感兴趣。

words.example_en: He started to learn the piano when he was very young.
words.example_zh: 他很小的时候就开始学习钢琴了。

words.example_en: The violin is not quite in tune with the piano.
words.example_zh: 小提琴跟钢琴的调子不太和谐。

words.example_en: She plays the cello in an orchestra.
words.example_zh: 她在管弦乐队中演奏大提琴。

words.example_en: She strummed her guitar, singing her own song.
words.example_zh: 她弹着吉他，唱着自己写的歌。

words.example_en: He played a tune on his harmonica.
words.example_zh: 他用口琴吹奏了一支曲子。

words.example_en: His performance as a trumpet player was quite revolutionary.
words.example_zh: 他作为小号手的演奏独具一格。

words.example_en: The drum beats were steady and slow.
words.example_zh: 鼓声平稳而缓慢。

words.example_en: The long-drawn-out sound of a flute is coming from far to near.
words.example_zh: 悠长的笛声由远而近。

words.example_en: There is a rise in unemployment, so the competition for jobs is very fierce.
words.example_zh: 失业人数上升了，所以求职竞争十分激烈。
words.notes: [记] compete v. 竞争  competitor n. 竞争者，对手

words.example_en: He has 65 tournament wins to his name.
words.example_zh: 他获得过65次联赛冠军。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 奥林匹克运动会的  n. [the ~s] 奥林匹克运动会
words.example_en: The most important part of the Olympics is to participate rather than to win.
words.example_zh: 在奥林匹克运动会中，最重要的是参与，而不是取胜。

words.meaning_zh: n. 发起人；主办人；赞助人  v. 发起；主办；赞助
words.example_en: The company had sponsored the football match.
words.example_zh: 公司已为这场足球赛提供了赞助。
words.notes: [记] sponsorship n. 资助

words.example_en: A wealthy patron has promised to send him to study overseas.
words.example_zh: 一个富有的赞助人答应要送他出国留学。
